description: Use this after import_menu to see whether the menu is ready. Returns pending, ready (with the menuId and a private ChefBear link to the menu) or failed with a reason; while the import is still running it waits up to about 10 seconds for it to finish before answering. Check at most twice in a row; if it is still pending, tell the user and check again on their next message. Read-only; does not use the recognition allowance.
name: get_import_status
title: Check menu import
